secondOpinion.text:
What this is
A web page claims you must pay an urgent delivery fee of one dollar and ninety-five cents for a package or it will be returned. It asks for your credit card details. I could not independently verify its claims.

Why I think so
The page uses high-pressure tactics, demanding action within thirty minutes. This is a common warning sign for scams that try to steal credit card information. 

What to do now
Do not enter your credit card details or any personal information on this page. Close the browser window immediately and ignore the message.
